name: kuching-3d
description: Real-world open-world walking simulator of Kuching, Sarawak, built from OpenStreetMap data.

scripts.data:fetch: node tools/extract-map-data/fetch-osm.ts && node tools/extract-map-data/fetch-pois.ts && node tools/extract-map-data/fetch-overture.ts && node tools/extract-map-data/fetch-dem.ts
scripts.data:build: node tools/generate-world/build.ts && npm run data:streetscape && npm run data:graph && npm run data:places && npm run data:jobs
scripts.data:all: npm run data:fetch && npm run data:build && npm run data:validate
